piezas.titulo: Production writing: Education, culture and community
texto: Guided writing on culture and community memory: write a coherent paragraph describing a custom or cultural celebration. Structures to use: 1) Concession: «แม้ว่า...แต่...». 2) Inclusion: «เปิดโอกาสให้...». 3) Coexistence: «...แลกเปลี่ยนประสบการณ์กัน». Keep the vocabulary dignified, inclusive and precise.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การจัดแสดงผลงานหัตถกรรมในพิพิธภัณฑ์ท้องถิ่นสะท้อนถึงวิถีชีวิตดั้งเดิม» express?

opciones.texto: The displays of crafts in the local museum portray traditional ways of life.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การจัดแสดงผลงานหัตถกรรมในพิพิธภัณฑ์ท้องถิ่นสะท้อนถึงวิถีชีวิตดั้งเดิม» from the text.

opciones.texto: Cooperation among community members is the essential foundation of sustainable development.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Local traditions are passed down from generation to generation through cultural events.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
